implementation: Fence token binds never-reset generation, binding_nonce, run/incarnation, mode, and reason; every close increments generation and stale open uses CAS rejection.
Action, ACK, journal/repository I/O, and mirror publication execute outside admission/coordinator/fence locks.
Review admission compares ticket, active run, fence run/incarnation, and current permit token.
Stale cancellation/error applies through captured binding only.

G3 request validates selected live exact target/pair and authority token after write_lock acquisition under the bridge condition immediately before pending registration; mismatch is zero-byte/no-retry.
Coordinator pause/resume/compensation and live automatic OMP delivery use bound transport submission.
